name: Kuala Lumpur Standard Chartered Marathon (KLSCM)
short_description: KLSCM is a full-marathon event held on 4 October 2026 at Dataran Merdeka, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, with registration open now.
ai_summary: The Kuala Lumpur Standard Chartered Marathon (KLSCM) is a full-marathon event taking place on 4 October 2026 at Dataran Merdeka in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Organized by Dirigo Events Sdn Bhd, it offers four distance options: 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. Registration is currently open, with pricing starting at MYR 150.
pros: Multiple distance options (42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, 5km) allow runners of different levels to participate
Iconic starting venue at Dataran Merdeka, a well-known landmark in Kuala Lumpur
Registration is currently open, giving runners time to prepare and secure a spot
Affordable entry price starting at MYR 150
cons: Only limited pricing information is available (starting price only, no full breakdown by distance)

research_highlights: Race is held as a two-day weekend format: shorter distances (5km, 10km, Kids Dash) on Saturday, and the Full Marathon plus Half Marathon on Sunday.
The 21.1km Half Marathon has historically flagged off very early, around 4:45am, with the Full Marathon starting even earlier (around 3:30am) to beat the heat.

In 2025 the course start moved away from the traditional Dataran Merdeka (closed for renovation works) to Jalan Raja Laut, with the finish moved to a new stadium finish inside Stadium Merdeka, which many runners described as a highlight of the race experience.
The race has grown into Malaysia's largest mass-participation event, with reported turnout of over 41,000 runners across categories in the 2025 edition.
Public registration slots have sold out within hours in recent years (2025 sold out the same day registration opened), so early sign-up is advised.
research_watchouts: Heat and humidity are frequently cited as tough, even with pre-dawn start times — one 2025 reviewer said the race carnival was hard to enjoy because 'the heat was so intense.'

Course/start-finish logistics have changed in recent years due to construction at the traditional Dataran Merdeka venue, so returning runners should double check the current-year start/finish points rather than assume it's the same as previous editions.
Early race starts (as early as 3:15–4:45am) mean runners need to plan sleep and transport/logistics carefully the night before.
Toilet queues near the start line have been reported as long in past editions, with some runners seeking alternatives at nearby hotels.

faqs.question: When is the Kuala Lumpur Standard Chartered Marathon (KLSCM) taking place?
faqs.answer: The Kuala Lumpur Standard Chartered Marathon is scheduled to take place on 4 October 2026. The event will be held at Dataran Merdeka in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, and is organized by Dirigo Events Sdn Bhd. Registration for the race is currently open for interested runners.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at KLSCM?
faqs.answer: KLSCM offers four distance categories for participants to choose from: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a shorter 5km race. This range allows both experienced marathoners and casual runners to take part in the event.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to register for KLSCM?
faqs.answer: Registration pricing for the Kuala Lumpur Standard Chartered Marathon starts at MYR 150. This price range applies to the event overall, though specific costs may vary depending on which distance category, such as the marathon, half marathon, 10km, or 5km, a runner chooses to enter.

faqs.question: Is registration currently open for KLSCM?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Kuala Lumpur Standard Chartered Marathon is currently open. Runners interested in participating in any of the four distance categories, including the full marathon, half marathon, 10km, or 5km, can sign up now ahead of the event on 4 October 2026.
